[LTAC.8.1] The compiler must name follow-up rules
`$<rule>_after_<N>`, where `<N>` is the source-order index
among `after` clauses on the parent rule. A synthetic name
([LLEX.10.6.1]) can't equal an author-written rule name.

idris.name: ltac_3_1__lower
idris.note: The follow-ups after their parent, each at the next ordinal. LESS than the clause: the names are the lowering's. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__follow_up
idris.note: The follow-up the lowering names `$<rule>_after_<N>`; the model carries its ordinal, the one after its parent's. LESS than the clause: the name is the lowering's. A fixture.
